ex.s: Indeed, to a computer, meaning is irrelevant.
ex.t: 的确，对计算机而言，意义是无关的。

ex.s: Indeed, when it comes to environmental transformations, we can develop a form of collective “poor memory”, and each new generation can believe the state of affairs they encounter is nothing out of the ordinary.
ex.t: 的确，在环境变化方面，我们会产生一种集体的"健忘"，每一代新人都可能认为他们所遇到的事态再正常不过。

ex.s: This indicates that Goffin’s cockatoos do indeed possess an allocentric frame of reference when moving objects in space, similar to two-year-old babies.
ex.t: 这表明戈芬氏凤头鹦鹉在空间中移动物体时确实拥有客体参照框架，类似于两岁婴儿。

ex.s: Indeed, it is thought that over four- fifths of living species on earth remain undiscovered.
ex.t: 事实上，据认为地球上超过五分之四的物种仍未被发现。

ex.s: Indeed, the researchers found that face-to-face interactions and conversations affect the creative process, and yet a coworking space or a coffee shop provides a certain level of noise while also providing freedom from interruptions.
ex.t: 的确，研究人员发现面对面互动和对话会影响创造过程，而联合办公空间或咖啡店提供一定程度的噪音，同时也提供不受打扰的自由。

ex.s: Dogs may indeed be able to distinguish between happy and angry human faces, according to a new study.
ex.t: 研究人员随后通过向狗展示人脸的另一半或与训练中使用完全不同的图像来测试狗区分人类面部表情的能力。

ex.s: But I imagine that, while money is indeed wonderful and necessary, rereading an author’s work is the highest currency a reader can pay them.
ex.t: 但我想，虽然金钱确实美好且必不可少，但重读一位作者的作品，是读者能给予他们的最高回报。

ex.s: It is not my intention to point out the central theme of each of the plays in this collection, for that would, indeed, ruin the pleasure of reading, discussing, and thinking about the plays and the effectiveness of the playwright.
ex.t: 我的本意不是指出这本集子里每部剧的中心主题，因为那确实会毁掉阅读、讨论、思考这些剧以及剧作家手法的乐趣。

ex.s: Certain forms of AI are indeed becoming ubiquitous.
ex.t: 某些形式的人工智能确实正在变得无处不在。

ex.s: If you are already making the time to exercise, it is good indeed!
ex.t: 如果你已经在腾出时间锻炼，那真是太好了！

ex.s: Indeed, they made only half as many errors as those wearing their own clothes on the Stroop Test( one way of measuring attention).
ex.t: 事实上，他们在斯特鲁普测试（一种测量注意力的方法）中犯的错误只有穿自己衣服者的一半。

ex.s: Indeed official figures suggest the country has shrunk by 5% since 1993 and people in Russia live a shorter life now than those in 1961.
ex.t: 事实上，官方数据显示，该国自1993年以来已缩减了5%，俄罗斯人的寿命现在比1961年时更短。

defs.def: （用于 very 和形容词或副词之后，强调叙述、描写等）真正地

ex.s: I guess love is indeed a magical ingredient.
ex.t: 我想爱确实是一种神奇的成分。

ex.s: By expressing love for his children in such a special way, Tolkien may indeed have been the real Father Christmas.
ex.t: 通过以如此特别的方式表达对孩子们的爱，托尔金也许确实是真正的圣诞老人。

ex.s: Indeed, they fear they may never see their children again.
ex.t: 确实，他们害怕再也见不到孩子们了。

ex.s: Indeed, some may argue that our need for humour is almost as great as our need for water and air.
ex.t: 确实，有人可能会说我们对幽默的需求几乎与对水和空气的需求一样大。
